Three.js — vendored locally so 3D pages load same-origin and work offline.
Source unmodified. License: MIT.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

Files under jsm/ mirror the upstream examples/jsm/ directory layout exactly
(same relative import paths), so the import map maps "three/addons/" -> "./jsm/"
matching the official three.js no-bundler setup convention.
